name: Celebrating Holidays
overview: Scripture reveals a tension regarding the celebration of holidays, highlighting the importance of discerning between God-ordained feasts and human traditions. While some appointed feasts and new moons are described as burdensome or displeasing to the Lord (Isaiah 1:14), the practice of commemorating significant events, as seen in Mordecai's letters to the Jews (Esther 9:20), shows that remembrance can be meaningful when aligned with God's purposes. Jesus warns against transgressing God's commandments through mere traditions (Matthew 15:3), emphasizing that celebrations must not contradict divine instruction. Believers are encouraged to accept one another in matters of conscience without engaging in judgment over disputable practices (Romans 14:1), underscoring a call for grace and unity amid differing views on holiday observance.
